domain_context: Analyze court cases to match new cases to prior cases by offense, propagate recommended citations through the citation graph, and return only recommended precedents whose decisions indicate a conviction was upheld.

predicate_verbalization.cases: Existing case arg0 has name arg1, offense arg2, punishment arg3, decision arg4, and convicted flag arg5.
predicate_verbalization.newcase: New case arg0 has name arg1 and offense arg2.
predicate_verbalization.mayCite: New case arg0 may cite case arg1 because they share the same offense.
predicate_verbalization.shouldCite: New case arg0 should cite case arg1 (directly or through transitive citation).
predicate_verbalization.relevantCase: For new case arg0, case arg1 is a relevant precedent with name arg2.
